reading.zh: 从左到右：策略定义什么算合格口令，锁定清单记录因连续失败被挡在门外的人。登录入口本体归身份模块（oa.identity.session.login.issue）。
reading.en: Left to right: the policy defines what a valid password is, and the lockout list records who has been shut out by repeated failures. The login endpoint itself lives in the identity module (oa.identity.session.login.issue).
